svg.title: Silver Layer Modelling: Bronze-to-Silver Conformance Pipeline in Fabric
svg.desc: An original architecture diagram tracing bronze Delta records in a Fabric Lakehouse through conformance, deduplication ordered by commit time, a schema-evolution guard, a data-quality gate that branches passing records into an SCD Type 2 merge and failing records into a quarantine table with a replay path back into the merge, then periodic Optimize and V-Order compaction, ending at conformed canonical silver Delta tables on OneLake that a Warehouse or semantic model reads for the gold layer. A warning callout flags that resolving 'latest row' without a deterministic ordering key corrupts SCD history.
svg.text: Silver Layer Modelling — bronze-to-silver conformance pipeline
Conformance · deduplication · SCD history · schema-evolution guard · data quality · canonical Delta layout

g.aria-label: Bronze intake — raw Delta table in the Lakehouse Tables area
g.title: Bronze intake — raw records already registered as Delta in the lakehouse metastore.

g.aria-label: Standardise types, names, and keys with a Spark notebook
g.title: Standardise — normalise column types, naming, and business keys across bronze sources.

g.aria-label: Deduplicate and prepare SCD historization ordering
g.title: Dedup & historize prep — collapse duplicate records per key, ordered by a deterministic commit-time column.

g.aria-label: Schema evolution guard for the merge target
g.title: Schema evolution guard — controls how new or changed bronze columns are allowed to reach the silver merge.

g.aria-label: Data quality gate — pass or quarantine
g.title: Data quality gate — evaluates each row against validity rules and branches pass/fail.

g.aria-label: SCD Type 2 merge into canonical silver entity
g.title: SCD Type 2 merge — merges passing (and replayed) records into the canonical silver entity with full history.
Quarantine table — failed records land here with a reason code, kept out of silver but never dropped.
g.text: triaged and corrected by an owner

g.aria-label: Warning: nondeterministic latest-row ordering corrupts SCD history
g.title: Warning — resolving "latest row" without a deterministic ordering key produces inconsistent SCD history on retry.

g.aria-label: Optimize, compact, and V-Order the merged Delta table
g.title: Optimize / V-Order — periodic compaction of small files, optionally applying V-Order for read-heavy silver tables.
Canonical silver entities — the published, deduplicated, quality-checked, history-aware Delta tables.

svg.text: SCD2-merged rows feed OPTIMIZE / V-Order, then land as canonical silver
Conformed silver Delta tables land here — one copy, every Fabric engine reads the same Parquet
separate schema or separate lakehouse per layer
GOLD-LAYER CONSUMPTION — READS SILVER, NEVER BRONZE DIRECTLY

g.text: stricter than bronze, looser than gold.

svg.text: Fabric Codex — original diagram, July 2026. Not a Microsoft asset; item icons vendored under Microsoft's Fabric icon terms.
